description_en: Creates an alert rule for a task in the new version of Data Integration. Currently supported task types include the full-database real-time synchronization solution from MySQL to Hologres
description_zh: 创建数据集成新版任务告警规则，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时解决方案
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-di-alarm-rule --di-job-id 11265 --metric-type Heartbeat --trigger-conditions Severity=Warning Duration=15 Threshold=5 --notification-settings '{"NotificationChannels":[{"Severity":"Warning","Channels":["Ding"]}],"NotificationReceivers":[{"ReceiverType":"DingToken","ReceiverValues":["token1"]}]}' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDIAlarmRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task. This is the ID of the task associated with the alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，是告警规则关联的任务ID
parameters.name: di_job_id

parameters.example: mysql synchronizes to hologres heartbeat alert
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The alert metric type. Valid values:
Heartbeat: task status alert
FailoverCount: failover count alert
Delay: task latency alert
parameters.help_zh:
告警指标类型，可选的枚举值：
Heartbeat（任务状态报警）
FailoverCount（failover次数报警）
Delay（任务延迟报警）
parameters.name: metric_type

fields.help_en: The time interval for alert calculation, in minutes
fields.help_zh: 告警计算时间区间，单位分钟
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:
Warning
Critical
fields.help_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
Warning
Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_en:
The alert threshold.
Task status alert: No threshold is required.
Failover count alert: The threshold is the number of failovers.
Task latency alert: The threshold is the latency duration, in seconds
fields.help_zh:
告警阈值。
任务状态报警：无需填写阈值。
failover次数报警：阈值为failover次数。
任务延迟报警：阈值为延迟时长，单位秒
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The list of alert trigger conditions. Multiple conditions are supported
parameters.help_zh: 告警触发条件列表，支持多条件
parameters.name: trigger_conditions

fields.help_en: The alert suppression interval, in minutes. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: 告警抑制间隔时长，单位分钟，默认5分钟
fields.name: inhibition_interval

fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:
Warning
Critical
fields.name: severity

fields.help_en: The alert notification channels. Multiple values are supported
fields.help_zh: 告警通知渠道，支持多值
fields.name: notification_channels

fields.help_en:
The recipient type.
When the alert notification channel is email, phone call, or text message, set the recipient type to Alibaba Cloud user ID (AliyunUid).
When the alert notification channel is DingTalk, set the recipient type to DingTalk token (DingToken)
fields.help_zh:
接收方类型。
当告警通知渠道为邮件、电话、短信时，接收方类型选择阿里云用户ID（AliyunUid）。
当告警通知渠道为钉钉时，接收方类型选择钉钉token（DingToken）
fields.name: receiver_type

fields.help_en: The alert notification recipients. Multiple values are supported
fields.help_zh: 告警通知接收方，支持多值
fields.name: notification_receivers

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the alert rule is enabled. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则是否启用，默认不开启
parameters.name: enabled
